gloss: outdated model; last year's model; discontinued model

definitions.gloss: outdated model; last year's model; previous-generation product
definitions.explanation: A product that is no longer the current model because a newer version has been released. Often sold at a discount. Common in discussions of electronics, cars, and appliances.

examples.japanese: {型落|かたお}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: You can buy outdated models cheaply.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{型落|かたお}ちだ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This computer is a previous model, but it's perfectly usable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{型落|かたお}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since the new model came out, the previous-generation refrigerator was heavily discounted.

notes:
USAGE:
{型落|かたお}ち combines ⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (model, type) and {落|お}ち (falling, dropping). The word implies that the product has dropped from being the current model. It is commonly used in consumer and retail contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {型落|かたお}ち⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (outdated-model product)
- {型落|かたお}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧ (previous-generation appliance)
- {型落|かたお}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧ (to aim for last year's model)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{旧型|きゅうがた}→旧型：18276_kyuugata⟧ means old model and is used more broadly, including for industrial or military equipment. {型落|かたお}ち specifically implies a consumer product that has been superseded by a newer version and is often associated with discount shopping.
